cues: A bottle cage bolts to a sloping tube, keeping a drink accessible without occupying either hand.
The wheelbase and steering angle shape whether the machine feels stable on straight roads or nimble in turns.
Some frames fold at a central hinge, shortening their footprint for storage in tight apartments.
A chain guard covers moving links, protecting loose trouser cuffs from grease and entanglement.
Clipless bindings lock compatible shoes onto small platforms, transferring force through each complete leg stroke.
A front basket mounts above the steering assembly, carrying groceries while shifting weight over the front wheel.
